name: slack-gif-creator
headline: Jobs-Tools: Optimize Your Job Search Efforts
short_description: Streamline your job search with jobs-tools, a powerful suite for LinkedIn outreach, email campaigns, resume organization, and network management. Enhance your efficiency and maintain a professional online presence effortlessly.
author: praneethravuri

sections.overview:
jobs-tools is a Python-based automation toolkit designed to streamline job applications and networking. It includes LinkedIn automation scripts for sending connection requests and bulk outreach, AI-generated personalized email campaigns via Ollama, resume generation from JSON data, and automated H1B visa sponsorship company research. The toolkit helps job seekers manage applications at scale while maintaining organization through automated resume filing by company and position. Use responsibly within LinkedIn's terms of service and Gmail's sending limits.
Automate LinkedIn outreach to potential employers
Organize job applications and resumes
Manage networking contacts and follow-ups
Create targeted email campaigns for job opportunities
sections.usage:
```
I'm looking for a job in [INDUSTRY]. Help me craft a LinkedIn outreach message to [COMPANY] that highlights my experience in [SKILL] and expresses my interest in their [POSITION]. Also, suggest a follow-up email template for candidates who don't respond to the initial message.
```
Copy

```
# LinkedIn Outreach Message

Hi [NAME],

I came across [COMPANY]'s profile and was impressed by your work in [INDUSTRY]. As a [POSITION] with [YEARS] of experience in [SKILL], I believe I could bring valuable insights to your team.

I'd love to connect and learn more about [COMPANY]'s culture and any potential opportunities. Would you be open to a quick chat?

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Best regards,
[YOUR NAME]

# Follow-up Email Template

Subject: Following Up on My LinkedIn Connection Request

Hi [NAME],

I wanted to follow up on my LinkedIn connection request and express my continued interest in [COMPANY]. I understand you're busy, but I believe my experience in [SKILL] could be valuable to your team.

Would you be available for a quick chat in the coming weeks? I'd love to learn more about [COMPANY] and share how I could contribute.

Looking forward to your response.

Best regards,
[YOUR NAME]
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
